issue.title: Review Reading Board lane order, Snoozed grouping, and density after two weeks

task_type_fields.proposal: After two weeks of actual use, review the Reading Board with Bryan: lane order, usefulness of Snoozed date versus waiting groups, and card density at normal Obsidian pane widths. Gather user observations before choosing any changes; if rollout was delayed, defer until there is enough use. Proposed by bob-cli-99.4 note 3. This is a bounded evaluation, not authorization to redesign the board or add writes.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic can ship and verify the board now, but a usage-based review needs elapsed time and owner feedback. Snooze to 2026-11-01 and re-evaluate availability of usage evidence then.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-99.4 note 3 requests a planned post-rollout review after real use, following the Reading Board plan.
